headline: APEC 2026: Claudia Sheinbaum and the Main Agreements from Her Trip to China
summary: Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum said a free trade agreement with China was ruled out during her trip to China. She said the economic relationship with the United States has a different dimension.
why: Mexico's trade policy toward China and the US affects tariffs, supply chains and investment decisions for companies exporting from or manufacturing in Mexico.
original_headline: APEC 2026: Claudia Sheinbaum y los principales acuerdos que dejó su viaje a China
